# Finest-level tile regression

`sammamish-14-2634-5717.batch.json` holds 609 building footprints for zoom 14, x 2634, y 5717 of
the bundled Sammamish `world.pmtiles`, adapted by the Earth binding and dumped through
`molen worldgen stats --dump` (buildings only, coordinates rounded to centimeters, normalized to
the tile). The outlines carry their mapped `context` (325 residential, 31 commercial, plus school,
pedestrian and grass), 87 mapped heights, 20 `building_part` labels, two footprints with holes and
five clipped at a tile seam. Keep the missing heights missing: the test proves the default pack
still produces mostly detailed, mostly pitched roofs in a neighborhood denser than the High detail
allowance, which only holds if the conservative fallbacks stay on the unmeasured buildings.

Provenance is checkable — the first outline's `f:35184401286210` is feature id `35184401286210` of
that tile in the committed archive.
